recommendations.title: Reduce render delay for Largest Contentful Paint text/container block
recommendations.description: The Largest Contentful Paint metric marks when the main visual content of the page has likely loaded.

finding.description: Largest Contentful Paint is 5.20s, exceeding the 2.5s threshold for good user experience.

recommendations.potentialImpact: Unblocks browser layout and font styling to render the main heading or text block earlier.
recommendations.suggestedFix: Eliminate render-blocking CSS/JS and inline critical styles required to paint the LCP text block immediately after DOM parse.
recommendations.issue: Reduce render delay for Largest Contentful Paint text/container block
recommendations.whyItMatters: Unblocks browser layout and font styling to render the main heading or text block earlier.
recommendations.reason: Delayed LCP element loading increases perceived page wait time for users.
recommendations.suggestedFixSummary: Eliminate render-blocking CSS/JS and inline critical styles required to paint the LCP text block immediately after DOM parse.

recommendations.title: Compress page images and convert to next-gen formats (WebP/AVIF)
recommendations.description: WebP and AVIF image formats provide superior compression performance compared to legacy PNG/JPEG, reducing download latency.

finding.description: 2 uncompressed or legacy image(s) detected with 84 KB potential reduction

recommendations.evidence: Analyzed 2 images; sample: https://developer.mozilla.org/pimg/aHR0cHM6Ly9zdGF0aWM0LmJ1eXNlbGxhZHMubmV0L3V1LzIvMTc5MTY0LzE3ODc2MDUyOTEtQXV0aDBfLV9Ib21lcGFnZV9Gb290ZXJfLV8xNDU2eDE4MC5wbmc%3D.Iql1tM4eOdS0f2iwvMUT1VXvf%2Bn%2BspecQ0pxpDSUeTA%3D can save 23.2 KB using WebP/AVIF
recommendations.potentialImpact: Reduces initial image payload bytes transmitted across the network.

estimatedSavings.assumption: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Fast 3G network profile (200 KB/s wire transfer rate; does NOT predict FCP/LCP/TBT improvement)
estimatedSavings.displayString: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Save ~0.42s transfer on Fast 3G (84 KB @ 200 KB/s)

recommendations.suggestedFix: Optimize raw image assets using sharp, imagemin, or dynamic CDN image transforms to compress payloads and serve next-gen formats (WebP/AVIF).
recommendations.issue: Compress page images and convert to next-gen formats (WebP/AVIF)
recommendations.whyItMatters: Reduces initial image payload bytes transmitted across the network.
recommendations.estimatedImprovement: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Save ~0.42s transfer on Fast 3G (84 KB @ 200 KB/s)
recommendations.estimatedPerformanceGain: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Save ~0.42s transfer on Fast 3G (84 KB @ 200 KB/s)
recommendations.actualValue: 2 uncompressed or legacy image(s) (84 KB potential savings)
recommendations.expectedValue: Serve modern WebP or AVIF image formats compressed for web viewing
recommendations.reason: Legacy image formats transfer excess bytes over the network, consuming bandwidth.
recommendations.suggestedFixSummary: Optimize raw image assets using sharp, imagemin, or dynamic CDN image transforms to compress payloads and serve next-gen formats (WebP/AVIF).

recommendations.title: Code-split and tree-shake unused JavaScript scripts
recommendations.description: Shipping unused JavaScript code increases download weight and CPU execution overhead.

finding.description: 55 KB of unused JavaScript code measured via Chrome DevTools Protocol Coverage

recommendations.evidence: CDP coverage profile measured 55 KB of unused code across script bundles
recommendations.potentialImpact: Reduces code transfer size and secondary parsing/compilation overhead on the main thread.

estimatedSavings.assumption: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Fast 3G network profile (200 KB/s wire transfer rate; does NOT predict FCP/LCP/TBT improvement)
estimatedSavings.displayString: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Save ~0.28s transfer on Fast 3G (55 KB @ 200 KB/s)

recommendations.suggestedFix: Implement dynamic import() route-based code splitting and configure production bundlers for dead code elimination.
recommendations.issue: Code-split and tree-shake unused JavaScript scripts
recommendations.whyItMatters: Reduces code transfer size and secondary parsing/compilation overhead on the main thread.
recommendations.estimatedImprovement: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Save ~0.28s transfer on Fast 3G (55 KB @ 200 KB/s)
recommendations.estimatedPerformanceGain: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Save ~0.28s transfer on Fast 3G (55 KB @ 200 KB/s)
recommendations.actualValue: 55 KB of unused JavaScript measured via Chrome DevTools Protocol Coverage
recommendations.expectedValue: Keep unused JavaScript code under 50 KB through route-based code splitting
recommendations.reason: Dead code transfers unnecessary bytes and consumes main thread memory during script parsing.
recommendations.suggestedFixSummary: Implement dynamic import() route-based code splitting and configure production bundlers for dead code elimination.

recommendations.title: Minify JavaScript assets to reduce payload size
recommendations.description: Minifying JavaScript removes whitespace, comments, and redundant formatting without altering behavior.

finding.description: 1 unminified JavaScript file(s) detected with 3 KB potential reduction

recommendations.potentialImpact: Reduces JavaScript asset download size and initial script parse overhead.

estimatedSavings.assumption: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Fast 3G network profile (200 KB/s wire transfer rate; does NOT predict FCP/LCP/TBT improvement)
estimatedSavings.displayString: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Save ~0.01s transfer on Fast 3G (3 KB @ 200 KB/s)

recommendations.suggestedFix: Integrate Terser, esbuild, or SWC into your production build pipeline to strip whitespace and shorten identifiers.
recommendations.issue: Minify JavaScript assets to reduce payload size
recommendations.whyItMatters: Reduces JavaScript asset download size and initial script parse overhead.
recommendations.estimatedImprovement: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Save ~0.01s transfer on Fast 3G (3 KB @ 200 KB/s)
recommendations.estimatedPerformanceGain: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Save ~0.01s transfer on Fast 3G (3 KB @ 200 KB/s)
recommendations.expectedValue: All production JavaScript assets should be minified with whitespace and comments stripped
recommendations.reason: Unminified JavaScript includes whitespace, comments, and un-mangled identifiers that increase download size.
recommendations.suggestedFixSummary: Integrate Terser, esbuild, or SWC into your production build pipeline to strip whitespace and shorten identifiers.

recommendations.title: Implement lazy loading for below-the-fold images
recommendations.description: Deferring offscreen images reduces initial page network competition and payload weight.

finding.description: 16 below-the-fold image(s) loaded synchronously without loading="lazy"

recommendations.evidence: 16 img element(s) detected without loading="lazy" attribute
recommendations.potentialImpact: Relieves initial network contention by deferring image requests outside the viewport.
recommendations.suggestedFix: Add loading="lazy" attribute to all 16 images that appear below the viewport fold.
recommendations.issue: Implement lazy loading for below-the-fold images
recommendations.whyItMatters: Relieves initial network contention by deferring image requests outside the viewport.
recommendations.expectedValue: Add loading="lazy" attribute to all non-hero images outside the initial viewport
recommendations.reason: Offscreen images load during critical page initialization, competing for network bandwidth.
recommendations.suggestedFixSummary: Add loading="lazy" attribute to all 16 images that appear below the viewport fold.

recommendations.title: Add descriptive alt attributes to image tags
recommendations.description: Screen readers require descriptive alt text to convey visual content to users with vision impairments.

finding.description: 17 image tag(s) lack alternative text descriptions in the rendered DOM

recommendations.evidence: 17 tag(s) without valid alt attribute identified in DOM
recommendations.potentialImpact: Enables screen readers to describe visual content to visually impaired users.
recommendations.suggestedFix: Provide descriptive alt="..." text descriptions for all image tags (affecting ~17 images) or empty alt="" for purely decorative graphics.
recommendations.issue: Add descriptive alt attributes to image tags
recommendations.whyItMatters: Enables screen readers to describe visual content to visually impaired users.
recommendations.expectedValue: All tags must possess meaningful alt attributes or alt="" if purely decorative
recommendations.reason: Screen readers announce uncaptioned filenames when alt attributes are missing, degrading accessible user experience.
recommendations.suggestedFixSummary: Provide descriptive alt="..." text descriptions for all image tags (affecting ~17 images) or empty alt="" for purely decorative graphics.
